description: Read a public seed page plus up to four same-origin linked pages and return compact readable text, headings, links, source hashes and evidence receipts. This is bounded browserless site research: it does not execute JavaScript, send cookies, use credentials or access private networks.

max_pages.description: Maximum same-origin pages to inspect, from 1 to 5. Defaults to 5.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) seed URL for the site to inspect.

name: inspect_site
title: Inspect a public website
